title: muster release v5.34.8

### Fixed
- **muster waits for its Valkey at start instead of crash-looping.** When muster and its Valkey restarted together (a reclaimed node), muster gave up on the session-store Valkey after 20 s and exited with `mcp-aggregator service failed`; the kubelet restarted it until Valkey was up (five restarts in three minutes, a `ContainerRestartingTooOften` page, every MCP call a 503). Now muster keeps dialling with capped backoff (1 s doubling to 8 s), one `Valkey for the session stores did not answer, retrying` line per attempt, and binds its port once Valkey answers: the pod is not ready while it waits and ready within seconds after. The chart's new `startupProbe` (`/health`, every 5 s, 60 failures) keeps the liveness probe off for up to 5 minutes of start. Only a configuration error ends the start: credentials or database refused, a malformed address, a certificate that does not verify. ([#1364](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/1364))
